c036.title: Planning a summer trip
c036.story: Anna and Max want a [[trip]] in August. They go to a travel [[bureau]] in Kyiv. An [[agent]] meets them with a smile. She works for a big [[tour operator]]. She shows them a [[low-cost]] flight. This plane flies [[nonstop]] to the coast. A [[charter]] is cheap too. Or they take a bus [[tour]] with a [[guide]]. "[[Tourism|tourism]] is very big this year," she says. "Every [[tourist]] wants to go to the sea." Max says, "You are a great [[travel agent]]!" They book two bus seats and smile.

c037.title: Uncle Ivan, the pilot
c037.story: Max's Uncle Ivan is a [[pilot]]. One Saturday he took Max and Anna to the airport. They sat in the [[cockpit]] of his big [[jet]]. "This is the [[radar]], and this is the [[transponder]]," he said. "Ships use [[sonar]] under the water, but we use radar." Anna asked, "Does the [[autopilot]] fly the plane for you?" At a small airfield, a [[helicopter]] landed with a very loud [[rotor]]. Next to it stood an old plane with a [[propeller]]. "My grandpa called it an [[aeroplane]]," Uncle Ivan said with a smile. "My old teacher flies that [[glider]], and he is a real [[ace]]." Then a man jumped from a plane with a red [[parachute]]. That evening Max practiced on a flight [[simulator]] for hours.

c038.title: Anna's new smartphone
c038.story: Anna's old phone broke, so she went shopping with Max. She wanted a high-end [[smartphone]] this time. "This one has a very fast chip," the shop assistant said. He showed her the [[camera]] and its strong [[zoom]]. Anna touched the big [[touchscreen]], and the display was bright and clear. Her finger on the [[sensor]] opened the phone at once. The assistant connected her headphones by [[Bluetooth]]. He also changed her [[ringtone]] to a happy song. "It's an expensive [[device]]," Anna said quietly. "But it's the best [[gadget]] in the shop," Max said. That evening, Anna called Grandma on her old home [[telephone]]. Grandma laughed, "You sound so clear today!"

c039.title: No signal in the metro
c039.story: Anna is in the metro. Her phone has no [[signal]]. There is no [[internet]] here. She cannot go [[online]]. Anna is [[offline]] for an hour. Then she walks up to the street. Her phone gets twenty [[messages|message]]. There is also an [[SMS]] from Mama. Max writes in the group [[chat]]: "Where are you?" Then Mama calls: "Why is your [[roaming]] on?" Anna laughs and turns it off.

c040.title: Max fixes Anna's laptop
c040.story: Anna's [[laptop]] was slow and full of [[glitches|glitch]]. So she called Max, who works in [[IT]]. He connected it to his own [[computer]] at home. Soon he found the problem in the [[software]], not the [[hardware]]. "First, let's make a [[backup]] of every [[file]]," he said. He saved them on a disk with a [[USB]] [[cable]]. Then he installed an [[update]] and did a [[reset]]. "Next year, you need a memory [[upgrade]]," Max said. He also showed her a keyboard [[shortcut]] for copying text. "It works like new now!" Anna said happily. "My [[desktop]] at work is still faster," Max joked.
